This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Traditional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal can be restrictive, especially for creators in countries like Zimbabwe. They can freeze your account, charge exorbitant fees, or even restrict your transactions. A sovereign digital commerce stack, on the other hand, gives you full ownership and control over your infrastructure, so you can sell your digital products without intermediaries like Stripe or PayPal. By deploying a stack using NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers, you can process payments directly on-chain, with no platform fees to worry about.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need to have a basic understanding of how it works. You'll need to set up a Cloudflare account, a NOWPayments account, and a GitHub or Cloudflare Pages account. You'll also need to create a digital product to sell, such as an ebook or a course. Additionally, you'll need to have a basic understanding of how to use Cloudflare Workers and GitHub Pages to host your digital products and process payments.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is a crucial step in deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack. You'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your Cloudflare Workers script to process payments directly on-chain. You'll also need to set up a delivery pipeline using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to deliver your digital products to customers automatically. This will ensure that customers receive their purchases immediately after paying, without any intermediaries.
You can sell digital products with crypto without relying on traditional payment platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. You'll need to test your payment gateway to ensure that it's working correctly, and then you can start selling your digital products to customers. Remember to track your transactions, monitor your analytics, and adjust your marketing strategy accordingly to maximize your sales.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The most important question you need to ask yourself is: Can I sell digital products with crypto without relying on traditional payment platforms like Stripe or PayPal? The answer is yes, by deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack using NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers, you can process payments directly on-chain, with no platform fees to worry about.
NOWPayments charges a flat 0.5% fee on every transaction.

If you're looking for more resources to help you build and deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, consider checking out the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. You can also find more information on our products page at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these concrete steps: Create a Cloudflare account and set up a GitHub or Cloudflare Pages account. Integrate NOWPayments with your Cloudflare Workers script to process payments directly on-chain. Set up a delivery pipeline using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to deliver digital products to customers automatically. Test your payment gateway to ensure it's working correctly. Start selling your digital products to customers and track your transactions, monitor your analytics, and adjust your marketing strategy accordingly.
Frequently Asked Questions
How does NOWPayments compare to Gumroad in terms of fees?

NOWPayments charges a flat 0.5% fee on every transaction, compared to Gumroad's 10% fee. This means that you can retain up to 99.5% of your sales revenue when using NOWPayments, compared to 90% when using Gumroad.
Can I use NOWPayments with any type of digital product?

Yes, you can use NOWPayments with any type of digital product, from ebooks and courses to software and plugins. NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, so you can accept payments in the currency of your choice.
How do I integrate NOWPayments with my Cloudflare Workers script?

You can integrate NOWPayments with your Cloudflare Workers script by following the instructions on the NOWPayments documentation page. This will involve setting up an API key, configuring your payment settings, and testing your payment gateway to ensure it's working correctly.
What is the best way to deliver digital products to customers automatically?

The best way to deliver digital products to customers automatically is to use a Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script delivery pipeline. This will ensure that customers receive their purchases immediately after paying, without any intermediaries. You can also use Cloudflare Pages to host your digital products and deliver them to customers automatically.
Can I use NOWPayments to accept payments in multiple cryptocurrencies?

Yes, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, so you can accept payments in the currency of your choice. You can also use NOWPayments to accept payments in multiple cryptocurrencies at the same time, by configuring your payment settings accordingly.
You can accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies with NOWPayments.
